lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal raaj sadaa har keraa tis bin avar na koee raam ||
lines.translation: The Kingdom of the Lord is permanent, and forever unchanging; there is no other than Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bin avar na koee sadaa sach soee guramukh eko jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: There is no other than Him - He is True forever; the Gurmukh knows the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan pir melaavaa hoaa guramatee man maaniaa ||
lines.translation: That soul-bride, whose mind accepts the Guru's Teachings, meets her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliaa taa har paaiaa bin har naavai mukat na hoee ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, she finds the Lord; without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਾਵੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman ka(n)tai raave man maaniai sukh hoee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord; her mind accepts Him, and she finds peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev dhan baalaReee har var paavahi soee raam ||
lines.translation: Serve the True Guru, O young and innocent bride; thus you shall obtain the Lord as your Husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa hovahi sohaaganee phir mailaa ves na hoee raam ||
lines.translation: You shall be the virtuous and happy bride of the True Lord forever; and you shall never again wear soiled clothes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir mailaa ves na hoee guramukh boojhai koee haumai maar pachhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Your clothes shall never again be soiled; how rare are those few, who, as Gurmukh, recognize this, and conquer their ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanee kaar kamaavai sabad samaavai a(n)tar eko jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: So make your practice the practice of good deeds; merge into the Word of the Shabad, and deep within, come to know the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh prabh raave din raatee aapanaa saachee sobhaa hoee ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh enjoys God, day and night, and so obtains true glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaaman pir raave aapanaa rav rahiaa prabh soee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Beloved; God is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee kaar kare dhan baalaReee har var dei milaae raam ||
lines.translation: Serve the Guru, O young and innocent soul-bride, and he will lead to you meet your Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai ra(n)g ratee hai kaaman mil preetam sukh paae raam ||
lines.translation: The bride is imbued with the Love of her Lord; meeting with her Beloved, she finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil preetam sukh paae sach samaae sach varatai sabh thaaee ||
lines.translation: Meeting her Beloved, she finds peace, and merges in the True Lord; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa seegaar kare din raatee kaaman sach samaaee ||
lines.translation: The bride makes Truth her decorations, day and night, and remains absorbed in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sukhadaataa sabad pachhaataa kaaman laiaa ka(n)th laae ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace, is realized through His Shabad; He hugs His bride close in His embrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mahalee mahal pachhaanai guramatee har paae ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the bride obtains the Mansion of His Presence; through the Guru's Teachings, she finds her Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan baalee dhur melee merai prabh aap milaaee raam ||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord, my God, has united His young and innocent bride with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee ghat chaanan hoaa prabh rav rahiaa sabh thaaee raam ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, her heart is illumined and enlightened; God is permeating and pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh rav rahiaa sabh thaaee ma(n)n vasaaee poorab likhiaa paaiaa ||
lines.translation: God is permeating and pervading everywhere; He dwells in her mind, and she realizes her pre-ordained destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sej sukhaalee mere prabh bhaanee sach seegaar banaaiaa ||
lines.translation: On his cozy bed, she is pleasing to my God; she fashions her decorations of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman niramal haumai mal khoee guramat sach samaaee ||
lines.translation: The bride is immaculate and pure; she washes away the filth of egotism, and through the Guru's Teachings, she merges in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਕਰਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aap milaaee karatai naam navai nidh paaee ||4||3||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends her into Himself, and she obtains the nine treasure of the Naam. ||4||3||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har hare har gun gaavahu har guramukhe paae raam ||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; the Gurmukh obtains the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵਹੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadino sabad ravahu anahad sabad vajaae raam ||
lines.translation: Night and day, chant the Word of the Shabad; night and day, the Shabad shall vibrate and resound.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad sabad vajaae har jeeu ghar aae har gun gaavahu naaree ||
lines.translation: The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates, and the Dear Lord comes into the home of my heart; O ladies, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi gur aagai saa dhan ka(n)t piaaree ||
lines.translation: That soul-bride, who performs devotional worship service to the Guru night and day, becomes the Beloved bride of her Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad vasiaa ghat a(n)tar se jan sabad suhaae ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings, whose hearts are filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are adorned with the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin ghar sad hee sohilaa har kar kirapaa ghar aae ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, their hearts are forever filled with happiness; the Lord, in His Mercy, enters into their hearts. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa man aana(n)d bhaiaa har naam rahe liv laae raam ||
lines.translation: The minds of the devotees are filled with bliss; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhe man niramal hoaa niramal har gun gaae raam ||
lines.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh is immaculate and pure; she sings the Immaculate Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal gun gaae naam ma(n)n vasaae har kee a(n)mrit baanee ||
lines.translation: Singing His Immaculate Praises, she enshrines in her mind the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinh man vasiaa seee jan nisatare ghat ghat sabad samaanee ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings, within whose minds it abides, are emancipated; the Shabad permeates each and every heart.
